fee_notes: Base Initial Franchise Fee is $75,000 for a single Honest1 Center. A 10% discount applies for qualified U.S. Veterans (resulting in $67,500). A 15% discount applies for existing franchisees purchasing a second or additional location (resulting in $63,750 per additional unit). Only one discount is granted if multiple discounts apply. The fee is non-refundable. Additional required pre-opening fees include a $15,000 coaching fee plus $2,500–$5,000 in travel expenses, and an estimated $1,000 Technology Fee.
raw_excerpt:
Individual Franchisee.  If you are granted the right to open one Honest1 Center, then you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $75,000.

Veteran Franchisee.  If you are a qualified United States Veteran, we will discount the Initial Franchise Fee by 10%.

Existing Franchisee.  If you purchase a second or additional franchises while you are an "Honest1" franchisee, the Initial Franchise Fee will be reduced by 15% off the then-current Initial Franchise Fee for an individual center and the same reduction will apply for each additional franchise purchased by you.  At the current Initial Franchisee Fee of $75,000, the franchise fee for the second and additional locations would be $63,750.
